description: For a fixed intuitionistically consistent axiom set \(S\), the canonical model \(\mathcal C_S\) has worlds \(W_S\), inclusion as accessibility, and \(P\Vdash p_i\) exactly when \(p_i\in P\). Its nonempty world set contains the specified \(\mathsf E(S,\bot)\). This model is chosen before the premises or conclusion.
